issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Stock.add(String) as returning void, but both the template and the solution implement Stock.add(String) to return an int (the new quantity or -1). This mismatch between the problem diagram and the provided code can confuse students about the expected return type and how to use the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the UML/specification with the code. Update the problem_statement.md UML to declare +add(String): int (or otherwise change the textual description to indicate that add returns the new quantity). Alternatively, if the intended API is void, change the template and solution implementations so Stock.add(String) returns void and adjust usages accordingly.
